title: The tumble wings upgrade
summary: One of the upgrades in R.E.P.O. gives the player wings: the game builds them from a wing transform with a left and a right, a light, a looping sound played from a local audio source, and a reference back to the player they belong to.
body: Some upgrades change a number, and one of them grows a pair of wings. That upgrade has its own logic, which is why it is a thing with parts rather than a setting that alters the player silently.
It is attached to the player. The upgrade holds a reference to the player avatar it belongs to, so the wings are built around a particular character rather than around the crew in general.
The wings are three transforms. There is a transform for the wings as a whole, and one for the left wing and one for the right, which is why they can move together or apart.
They are lit. There is a light belonging to the wings, so the upgrade is visible in a dark level rather than only being seen when something else illuminates it.

They sound like something running. There is a loop for the wings, played through a local audio source, which is why the sound belongs to your own character rather than coming from somewhere in the level.
What this entry does not tell you: what the upgrade costs, how long you can stay in the air, or how bright the wings are. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The upgrade refers to the player avatar it belongs to.
The wings have a transform of their own with a left and a right wing transform.
There is a light belonging to the wings.
There is a looping sound for the wings played from a local audio source.
